headline: Executive order directs federal agencies to carry out a regulation-cutting effort tied to the Department of Government Efficiency.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order tells federal agencies to put in place a deregulation effort linked to the "Department of Government Efficiency" (DOGE). It appears to focus on reviewing federal rules and reducing or changing those the administration views as unlawful or unnecessary. No official summary was provided, so the specific steps, standards, and deadlines are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Agencies are likely directed to review their regulations and work with the DOGE effort to identify rules to cut or change.

who_it_affects.group: Businesses and others subject to federal rules
who_it_affects.how: They could see some federal regulations they must follow changed or removed, depending on what agencies decide.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 19, 2025; specific deadlines are not stated in the title.
